### 2026-10-20 – This is an entry for yesterday and practically just a clone of my idea reel.

**2.4h**

This is an entry for yesterday and practically just a clone of my idea reel.

I forgot to make a reel, again, so i couldn't put this in yesterday. First of all I created a bill of materials so I didnt create something that I cant finance. After that I sketched out a little drawing on what I wanted my version to look like. After that I realized that the micro-controller would not have enough pins. So I worked on finding out what would work, and it was the same as halflifes.

Contuining to forget the reel I created a schematic with 15 leds, which I hope isnt overkill. Nothing much to say about it lol, had to download the half life files first ig.

Thanks for reading.

### 2026-10-23 – Time to catch up...

**2.9h**

Time to catch up...

No school on friday luckily, I haven't had much time to work on the project this week due to school. So today I worked for a while in order to try and catch up. I remade my footprint of the little touch sensitive pads. It took me a while to figure out making shapes and such. But enventually I got it done. When I was finished with that I moved onto designing the board.

For the board I made a layout that I though worked nicely. I really liked my star design from week 1 so I did the same thing with this board. I used LEDS to make the stars glow, they are made to shine through the stars. All i did was place the compenents and draw the design. Tommorrow ill get to work on routing this board which looks to be a nightmare.

Thanks for reading.

### 2026-10-23 – Painful Tracing

**3h**

Painful Tracing

Before I was able to get to working on the project I had to make a 5h progress reel.  It was pretty easy, my longest reel yet. Im not sure exactly what to caption the reels.

After making the reel I started working on the project itself. I traced ~70 different connections. I have 3 leftover after today. These next 3 will be very painful. Im sure there will need to be changes to get the traces connected. I didnt have any major issues while tracing.

2 more days till submission!

Thanks for reading.

### 2026-10-25 – Days never ending, master got me working

**5.2h**

Days never ending, master got me working

Feels like it lol, I didnt get any work done yesterday, my parents decided to tell me on that day that our out of town friends would be coming over. So today I had to lock in, therefore 5.2 hours of work. I might work on code later tonight in order to get more hours.

First thing I did was finish routing the board which took much longer then expected. Long story short I deleted one of my LEDS at one point, so I spent a long time rerouting tracks and moving things around to fit it in. Once I finished doing that and routing the 3 tracks from yesterday I did a design rules check. There were around 64 errors, yeah sounds like alot but 60 of them were from the 15 leds which is to be expected. So just 4 errors and they were all with clearances between components. Which I worked out.

After that (which took up most of the time) I worked on getting everything onto the github and the readme. All the uploads went smoothly. Took me a while to get the readme sorted, just alot of things to type out in general. Thne hardest part was getting the BOM into it. I had to use a converter for the correct format.

Thanks for reading
